blurb: Guests join 2-hour dolphin and wildlife cruises through the Thousand Islands of Cocoa Beach on the Banana River Lagoon. There is also a 90-minute sunset cruise departing from the Sunset Waterfront Bar & Grill. Tours feature knowledgeable naturalist guides and shaded seating for every passenger.

quotes.author: Marianna Nay
quotes.text: We booked private party with Cocoa Beach Dolphin tours, and had an amazing experience, it was very nice and relaxing ride, we have seen many dolphins and a lot of other wildlife, our Captain and a tour guide were wonderful, extremely helpful and professional, we all loved it and had absolutely wonderful time, everything we expected and more. We would definitely do it again. Thank you Cocoa Beach Dolphin tours for an amazing experience.

quotes.author: Michele Shaw
quotes.text: Cocoa Beach dolphin tour we saw a ton of dolphins even baby ones that were learning how to fish saw manatee lots of birds Diane and Captain. Rich were fun to be around.. first mate Diane made sure all the kids were involved and engaged and had a great time as well as the adults. I would recommend it.

quotes.author: Jennifer Singleton
quotes.text: Had a cruise with Bill and Bob, they were very informative and let my son drive the boat! Highly recommend and please tip your tour guides! I only had videos of the dolphins but it won’t let me load those.

quotes.author: Shraddha Srivastav Strennen
quotes.text: Bill and Bob were wonderful! We didn’t get to see much (2 dolphins and several birds) because of the weather but they certainly tried.

quotes.author: Clementine Findlay
quotes.text: This is my second time with Dolphin Tours. The guides are very informative. They make the tour interesting, relaxing and fun!!

quotes.author: Ashley Robinson
quotes.text: Nice sunset tour! It was calm and leisurely and we got to see some wildlife!
